ref: ADR-0006 Consequences, SUPPRESS through the context functions since #51 (assumed): sortByKey orders a SUPPRESS key as the smallest in a lexicographic comparison; the SUPPRESS comes from createIf, true for 1 or true and SUPPRESS for 0 or false, in any case, and anything else ends the run with po:CREATEIF (ADR-0006 amended, F-37; fn/createIf/002); observation #61
note: The keys, createIf over Tag in context Orders, are "", SUPPRESS, "", SUPPRESS; the values are s1 to s4. Ascending puts the SUPPRESS keys first, in input order: s2, s4, s1, s3. SUPPRESS last gives s1, s3, s2, s4.
